verdict.rationale: HumanLayer orchestrates coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) through task workflows (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented) that can implement code changes end-to-end with review checkpoints, but the evidence never explicitly mentions the agent writing tests as part of implementation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated test generation/execution, evidence of fully autonomous completion without human gating, and independent confirmation of end-to-end feature delivery quality.
